title: Dataset of Speech Production in intracranial Electroencephalography (SingleWordProductionDutch-iBIDS)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 10 Dutch-speaking patients with pharmaco-resistant epilepsy who read aloud 100 Dutch words presented one at a time on a laptop screen. Intracranial EEG (1103 contacts spanning cortical and deep structures) was recorded simultaneously with pitch-shifted speech audio. The dataset supports research on speech production, speech decoding and brain-computer interfaces, and includes electrode localisation and FreeSurfer derivatives.
methods_description: sEEG was acquired with Dixi Medical Microdeep shafts and Micromed SD LTM amplifiers, at 1024 or 2048 Hz and downsampled to 1024 Hz. Audio was recorded at 48 kHz with a notebook microphone and pitch-shifted for anonymity. Neural, audio and stimulus streams were synchronised with LabStreamingLayer. Participants read each word aloud for 2 s, followed by a 1 s fixation cross. Electrodes were localised by co-registering pre-implant T1 MRI with post-implant CT using img_pipe, with labels from the Destrieux atlas.
